column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each shipment record in the database.
A TIMESTAMP field indicating the exact date and time this shipment record was logged.
A VARCHAR(30) descriptor for the routing alignment or path code used by the shipment.
An enum (CustomsFlag_enum) representing the customs clearance status (e.g., 'Cleared', 'In Process', 'Pending').
A VARCHAR(50) referencing the import permit number or identifier for the shipment.
A VARCHAR(50) referencing the export permit number or identifier for the shipment.
A VARCHAR(50) signifying the regulatory or profile reference for this shipment.
An enum (InsuranceFlag_enum) capturing the insurance status (e.g., 'Active', 'Expired', 'Pending').
A VARCHAR(50) referencing the insurance policy or coverage document number.
An enum (QualityCheck_enum) indicating the quality check result (e.g., 'Failed', 'Passed', 'Pending').
An enum (IntegrityStatus_enum) showing the shipment’s integrity status (e.g., 'Intact', 'Under Investigation', 'Compromised').
An enum (ContaminationRisk_enum) denoting potential contamination risk level (e.g., 'High', 'Low', 'Medium').
An enum (SterilityStatus_enum) indicating sterility status (e.g., 'Unknown', 'Compromised', 'Maintained').
An enum (PackageCondition_enum) describing the package condition (e.g., 'Excellent', 'Fair', 'Poor', 'Good').
An enum (SecuritySealStatus_enum) for the security seal status (e.g., 'Broken', 'Intact', 'Missing').
A VARCHAR(50) referencing a security seal ID or documentation.
An enum (TamperEvidence_enum) noting tampering evidence (e.g., 'None Detected', 'Suspected', 'Confirmed').
A TEXT field for special handling instructions or guidelines for the shipment.
A VARCHAR(40) specifying how the shipment must be positioned or oriented during storage/transport.
A TEXT field for any additional free-form notes regarding the shipment.
